words.definition_en: the power or skill to do something
words.example_en: She has the ability to solve the problem.

words.definition_en: n. a set of printed pages; v. to arrange something in advance
words.example_en: I read a book about stars every night.
words.definition_zh: n. 书；书本 v. 预订

words.definition_en: the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday
words.example_en: We have a music lesson on Friday.

words.definition_en: a sweet cold food made from milk
words.example_en: I like eating ice cream in summer.
